answer: Q#45 is answered in the outline (Akien 2026-11-06, commit 6b4a193e): real-time bus inspection is not needed now; when there is a bus feed it is a sub-panel off the Cairn device's page — CairnComponentOutline.txt: "5.5.3.7 Real-time inspection of bus traffic is not needed. Logging the messages to the transient pool (4.3.2) "might not be a completely bad idea".
